title: Manayunk, Philadelphia — Ida 2021, Schuylkill River flood
about: The Schuylkill through Manayunk crested 13.0 m at the Manayunk gauge on 2 Sept 2021. 11 USGS high-water marks scored (3 under bridge decks are not), the Manayunk and Wissahickon gauges inside the model; the river outlet holds the Philadelphia gauge (Fairmount Dam) carried up the river. docs/METHODS.md §5.8.

title: Forest Hills, Queens — Ida 2021, street and basement flooding
about: 72 mm fell in one hour at about 9 pm on 1 Sept 2021 over a combined-sewer area. USGS high-water marks (flash flooding), the USGS depth maps made from them, and NYC 311 street-flooding reports. docs/METHODS.md §5.9.

title: Forest Hills, Queens — Ida 2021, uncertainty band (4 m speed mode)
about: The Forest Hills case in the 4 m speed mode (depths at 1 m) with its batch variants: roughness × 0.8 and × 1.2, infiltration × 0.5, the 8 m screening mode. The band is the spread of the five runs at each mark (src/uncertainty.js). docs/METHODS.md §5.9, §5.11.

title: Forest Hills, Queens — against the NYC DEP Moderate Stormwater Flood Map
about: A 2.13 in/hr design storm (NYC DEP Moderate, current sea level) against DEP's own InfoWorks ICM map of it: another model, not an observation, so it does not count in a verdict. docs/METHODS.md §5.10.

title: Edwards Branch, Charlotte NC — 12 June 2025, real storm sewers
about: A 2.5 km² urban watershed above USGS 0214643820 (Edwards Branch at Sheffield Dr), which set its record on 12 June 2025: 9.90 ft, 2,560 cfs at 8:50 pm EDT. The City of Charlotte's own storm pipes (sizes, shapes and surveyed inverts), inlets and outfalls are linked, not synthesised: the first case with a real sewer. Scored on the gauge's peak level and its time. Pipe data: City of Charlotte, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial). docs/METHODS.md §5.12.

title: Edwards Branch, Charlotte NC — 9 January 2024, winter storm
about: The second-highest peak at USGS 0214643820 since the radar archive starts (Sept 2013): 8.26 ft, 881 cfs on 9 January 2024, a winter storm on wet ground. Same area, storm sewers and settings as the June 2025 case; a storm a calibration tuned on June 2025 never saw (tools/calibrate.mjs). Scored on the gauge peak. Pipe data: City of Charlotte, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. docs/METHODS.md §6.4.

title: Edwards Branch, Charlotte NC — 10 August 2023, summer storm
about: A summer cloudburst at USGS 0214643820: 7.21 ft, 692 cfs on 10 August 2023. Same area, storm sewers and settings as the June 2025 case; a storm a calibration tuned on June 2025 never saw (tools/calibrate.mjs). Scored on the gauge peak. Pipe data: City of Charlotte, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. docs/METHODS.md §6.4.
